summary: Explains how users can add frequently used options as quick links on their dashboard for easy access to daily tasks.
steps: Identify a frequently used option (e.g., 'Collect Fee').
Use the 'Quick Link' option to add it to your dashboard.
The added quick link will appear on your dashboard for direct access.
business_rules: Users can add an N number of links according to their daily usage.
important_notes: This feature is useful for roles like a fee clerk who frequently uses options like 'Collect Fee'.
questions: How can I add a quick link to my dashboard?
Can I customize the quick links on my ERP interface?
Are quick links specific to each user?
